# Discover project

Read the [profile](../../../docs/project-profile.md) and
[standard](../../../docs/standards/delivery.md). Inspect root instructions, dirty
state, manifests, entry points, tests, customisations and any actual deployment setup.
Do not assume generic examples in instructions are installed tools.

Record Evidenced facts with paths/revisions, Inferred conclusions with reasons,
and Unknowns with owners. Ask only unresolved questions. Preserve unrelated work.
Reconcile the profile and architecture; do not silently make observed behaviour
an approved requirement. Check effective prompt/agent/skill names and record
unavailable host scopes as Unverified.

Output: draft profile/architecture evidence and remaining gaps. No feature changes.
